name: Lumina Metals Corp.
summary: Lumina Metals Corp. engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties in Canada and Poland. It primarily explores copper and silver deposits. Its flagship project is the Nowa Sól project covering an area of 120 square kilometers located in Lubuskie Province, Poland. The company was formerly known as Miedzi Copper Corp and changed its name to Lumina Metals Corp. in December 2024. Lumina Metals Corp. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
